brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Something to keep sewing supplies tidy - compartmentalized storage
requirements.evidence: 3-cell cluster: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) + bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) + bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full (large open bin for fabric/scissors) provides 6 separate sections for thread spools, bobbins, needles, scissors, tape measure etc.

requirements.requirement: Staged to show sewing use with props
requirements.evidence: Bins sized for sewing notions (small compartments for bobbins/buttons, large bin for fabric). Prop dress attempted with tape, rulers, etc. but configurator returned BUSY/TIMED_OUT for prop settling - build verified clear with check_build, props could be added later manually.

finish.summary: Three-cell Hex Cluster organizer: 2-compartment bin, 3-compartment bin and full bin give 6 tidy sections for sewing supplies. Large bin holds fabric and scissors, small compartments hold bobbins, needles, buttons and thread. Caps and joint bolts finished. Props timed out on settling but structure is ready for sewing storage.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
